Respondent/s
 ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Girjanand Prasad, Advocate
 For the UoI : Ms. Vandana Kishore, Advocate
 For the Nhai : Mr. Anand Kumar, Advocate
 For the State : Mr.Sajid Salim Khan ( Sc 25 )
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Dr. Anshuman
 Oral Judgment

Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned counsel for the Union of India,
learned counsel for the National Highways Authority of India and learned counsel for the State.
2. The present writ petition has been filed for enhancement of compensation amount which has been prepared and the petitioner has received the same with objection.

3. Counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is entitled to receive the compensation amount treating his land as residential whereas Award has been Patna High Court CWJC No.6278 of 2023 dt.12-09-2023 calculated treating his land as agricultural.
Counsel further submits that Annexure-4 is the information communicated to the petitioner under Section 3E of the National Highways Act, 1956.

sentences.text:
4. Counsel for the National Highways Authority of India submits that since the Award has already been prepared and the petitioner has accepted the Award with objection then in that case the liberty is available to the petitioner to file an application under Section 3G(5) of the National Highways Act,
1956 before the Arbitrator-cum-Divisional Commissioner.

5. In this view of the matter, the present writ petition is disposed of directing the petitioner to file a fresh representation along with a copy of this order before the Arbitrator-cum-Divisional Commissioner, Patna raising all his points within four weeks, who shall decide his representation within nine months thereafter.

(Dr. Anshuman, J) Ashwini/-
